title: SE + ProServices: customer handoff and open actions (weekly sync)
content:
Weekly SE + ProServices sync — notes and action log
Date: 2026-11-21
Attendees: Aisha (SE lead), Liam (ProServices PM), Sofia (field eng), Diego (SRE on-call), Priya (customer success) + guest from Veridian (Alex) for first 20m
Duration: 45m
Objective: consolidate handoff items for customer integrations in flight, highlight escalations and ensure clear owners and dates for next milestones.

Agenda:
- Quick round robin: 1–2 line status per active customer (10m)
- Deep dive: Veridian deployment gaps and migration plan (15m)
- Open actions and blockers review (10m)
- Risk register updates + next steps (10m)

Summary / Key decisions:
- Final go/no-go for Veridian greenfield rollout moved to 2026-12-02 to allow extra validation of prefix-caching behavior (decision driven by customer QA scope).
- LumenHealth will remain on Dedicated beta until audit window closes; ProServices to prepare final compliance checklist by 2026-11-29.
- NovaCommerce: decided to standardize on quantized 8-bit variant for cost target; SE to validate quality regressions against 200-sample eval set by 2026-11-26.

Customer updates (notes + immediate blockers):
1) Veridian (in onboarding, target prod pilot Q4)
- Current status: staging cluster configured in us-west-2. End-to-end tests passing for short contexts (<=256 tokens).
- Blocker: intermittent tokenization mismatch on docs with non-UTF8 chars (seen in 3/50 sample uploads). Root cause suspected in preprocessing lambda (edge-case with legacy encoder).
- Customer ask: ability to flush KV cache per conversation ID from console or API (they want to implement session-level resets for legal review workflows).
- Action items: 
  - Diego to trace tokenization pipeline and add failing sample to reproducer by 2026-11-23. (owner: Diego)
  - Aisha to draft API change request for "session cache flush" and surface to product for prioritization (owner: Aisha) — due 2026-11-24.
  - Alex (Veridian) to provide 10 failing documents and sample filenames (owner: Alex) — due 2026-11-22.

2) LumenHealth (compliance-sensitive, Dedicated)
- Current status: Dedicated capacity provisioned; connectivity review with customer security team in progress.
- Blocker: customer requested quarterly key rotation support and HSM-backed signing which is not in the current Private deployment checklist.
- Action items: 
  - Liam to coordinate with security-and-compliance to produce a short KMS/HSM integration spec for customer by 2026-11-29. (owner: Liam)
  - Priya to prep customer-facing runbook describing rotation cadence and controls by 2026-11-28. (owner: Priya)

3) NovaCommerce (high-volume ecommerce customer)
- Current status: evaluation of 8-bit quantized variant ongoing on dedicated test queue. Throughput looks good but 1.8% accuracy drop on checkout intent classifier.
- Blocker: quantization regression threshold unclear; product wants explicit SLO for quality delta before approving as standard.
- Action items: 
  - Sofia to run A/B test on 5k in-scope prompts and produce ROC/precision-recall delta report by 2026-11-26. (owner: Sofia)
  - SE to prepare rollback plan and runtime knob list (how to flip between model variants at route-level) by 2026-11-25. (owner: Aisha)

4) AtlasRetail (pilot, offline ingest pipeline)
- Current status: ingestion pipeline intermittently throttled by prefix caching warm-up. Pipeline team prototyped a staggered pre-warm policy.
- Blocker: lack of visibility into cache hit metrics per-customer in the console (customer wants SLA evidence).
- Action items: 
  - Diego to add temporary per-customer cache hit dashboard (internal) and share link by 2026-11-24. (owner: Diego)
  - Field eng to capture warmup timings for 3 representative feeds and post to shared runbook by 2026-11-25. (owner: Sofia)

Open action review (consolidated):
- SE backlog items that need product prioritization: 
  - "session cache flush" API (Aisha) — draft due 2026-11-24, escalate to product if no prioritization by 2026-11-27.
  - Support for per-customer cache metrics in Console (Diego -> product request) — PoC dashboard by 2026-11-24.
- ProServices operational tasks: 
  - KMS/HSM integration spec for LumenHealth (Liam) — 2026-11-29.
  - Compliance runbook + customer walkthrough materials (Priya) — 2026-11-28.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Veridian tokenization mismatch could delay pilot >1 week. Mitigation: create a small preprocessor shim in staging to normalize encodings; incremental deploy if passes internal tests. (Owner: Diego)
- Risk: NovaCommerce quality regression after quantization could erode trust. Mitigation: strict A/B traffic cap (10%) + auto-roll back threshold in runtime policy. (Owner: Aisha)
- Risk: Dedicated customers asking for bespoke cryptographic integrations may increase implementation lead time. Mitigation: create a templated KMS/HSM pattern doc and reuse across customers. (Owner: Liam)

Meeting notes / ad-hoc items (informal):
- Quick idea: add a lightweight "customer readiness" badge in Console (red/amber/green) surfaced on the customer detail page — helps CSMs at-a-glance. (assigned: Priya to mock)
- Diego flagged an SRE note: nightly compacting job increased latency for staging GPUs last night; follow-up alert created (SE-3421).
- Sofia: have started collecting representative prompts for NovaCommerce from their test store; needs a secure upload link. Priya will coordinate.

Decisions to record:
- Push Veridian pilot to 2026-12-02 (consensus).
- Approve A/B quantization trial at 10% traffic for NovaCommerce (consensus conditional on Sofia's report).

Next sync: 2026-11-28 10:00 PT — standup format: 20m rapid statuses, 20m escalation triage, 10m parking lot.

Parking lot / future items:
- Explore adding per-route quality monitoring signals to Rollouts (tie to Evaluate/Optimize).
- Draft template for KMS/HSM security questionnaire for sales handoff.

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Follow up with Product on prioritization path for session cache flush API; if no movement by 2026-11-27, raise to Eng PM sync.
- Ensure the Veridian reproducer is saved in the SE reproducers folder and ping Alex for missing metadata.

Raw links (internal):
- Reproducer folder: //drive/shared/se/reproducers/veridian/ (internal, see Alex)
- Jira tickets: SE-3421 (SRE alert), PS-2198 (LumenHealth compliance request)
- Confluence: /display/PS/Onboarding+Playbooks

Action item digest (quick):
- Diego: tokenization reproducer + cache dashboard (due 11-23 / 11-24)
- Aisha: session cache flush API draft + rollback plan (due 11-24 / 11-25)
- Liam: KMS/HSM spec (due 11-29)
- Priya: compliance runbook + upload link coord for NovaCommerce (due 11-28 / 11-24)
- Sofia: NovaCommerce A/B eval + feed warmup timings (due 11-26 / 11-25)

If anything above is missing or mis-attributed, reply in thread and I'll update.

-- Aisha
